name: Neon dusk
description: Flat-shaded synthwave and sunset cityscapes where a magenta-to-violet gradient sky sits over a dark horizon.
light: low sun or glowing disc on the horizon; warm orange-pink rim against deep violet shadow; neon signs as the only other source
composition: strong horizontal bands (sky / skyline / ground), one centred or rule-of-thirds focal disc or tower, lots of empty gradient sky, small human silhouettes for scale
camera_or_medium: digital vector or pixel-art illustration, flat colour planes, soft gradients; no lens effects
mood: nostalgic, quiet, solitary; evening calm rather than action
texture_detail: clean edges, minimal grain, few small windows or grid lines as detail; simple shapes over rendered realism
